title: Death Note
synopsis: A high school student finds a supernatural notebook. A person dies when their name is written inside it. A brilliant detective tries to identify the secret killer.

title: Naruto
synopsis: An orphan boy trains to become a ninja and dreams of leading his village. A powerful nine-tailed creature is sealed inside him.

title: One Piece
synopsis: A young pirate with a stretchy rubber body gathers a crew. They sail across dangerous seas searching for a legendary treasure.

title: Shingeki no Kyojin
synopsis: People shelter in cities behind enormous walls. Giant humanlike creatures break through the walls and eat humans. Young soldiers fight them using special flying equipment.

title: Sen to Chihiro no Kamikakushi
synopsis: A girl enters a mysterious world where her parents become pigs. She works in a bathhouse for spirits and tries to save her family.

title: Cowboy Bebop
synopsis: A crew of bounty hunters travel between planets on a spaceship. They chase criminals in a future where humanity has spread through the solar system.

title: Steins Gate
synopsis: A self-proclaimed mad scientist and his friends accidentally discover how to send messages into the past with a modified microwave. Their experiments change the present.

title: Violet Evergarden
synopsis: A former child soldier with mechanical arms becomes a letter writer after a war. Helping other people express their feelings teaches her about emotions and love.
